name: Teaching and learning
summary: Use eClass, assessments, lecture capture and course technology

details.title: eClass
details.html: eClass is York’s Moodle-based learning management system. Students use it for course content, assessments and discussion activities. Instructors can manage course materials, quizzes, discussions and multimedia resources

details.title: Teaching applications
details.html: York supports learning technology such as Turnitin, iClicker, course evaluation tools, lecture recording and other teaching systems. Availability and configuration vary by course, instructor and approved teaching environment

details.title: Support
details.html: For issues with the setup or operation of learning technology, use the Learning Technology Services help centre. Assignment-specific questions and course requirements should also be discussed with the instructor
